title: The Apache web server must be tuned to handle the operational requirements of the hosted application.
check_content:
Verify the "Timeout" directive is specified in the Apache configuration files to have a value of "60" seconds or less.

If the "Timeout" directive is not configured or set for more than "60" seconds, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Add or modify the "Timeout" directive in the Apache configuration to have a value of "60" seconds or less.

"Timeout 60"

Restart the Apache service.
VulnDiscussion: A denial of service (DoS) can occur when the Apache web server is so overwhelmed that it can no longer respond to additional requests. A web server not properly tuned may become overwhelmed and cause a DoS condition even with expected traffic from users. To avoid a DoS, the Apache web server must be tuned to handle the expected traffic for the hosted applications.
